CSV to Markdown

Convert CSV to a Markdown table — proper parsing of quoted commas, escaped quotes and multiline fields.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your CSV data.
  2. Choose column alignment and whether the first row is a header.
  3. The Markdown table generates live.
  4. Copy it or download as table.md.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are quoted commas handled?

With a real CSV parser: fields wrapped in double quotes may contain commas, newlines and escaped "" quotes.

What if my CSV has no header row?

Untick "first row is header" and generic Column 1…N headers are used.

How is alignment set?

Left, center or right — applied to every column via the separator row (:---, :---:, ---:).

Are cells trimmed?

Optional — tick "trim cells" to strip surrounding whitespace from every field.
